## IGramstaxPlanSource type

Provenance of a resolved `IGramstaxBuildPlan` value.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type IGramstaxPlanSource = `config` | `default`;
```

## Remarks

`config` means the value came from an explicit key in `gramstax.config.ts` (see `loadExplicitBuildKeys`<!-- -->); `default` means the fallback was used. `IGramstaxBuildPlan.adapterSource` widens this with `flag` when `--target` was passed on the command line.
